quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to talk about your favorite part of the whole day"?
quests.question: Share Something Good About Today
quests.hint: This happens during a cozy chat, right before bedtime.
quests.explanation: Yes! We share something good about today to end the day on a happy note.
quests.funFact: Thinking of one happy moment before bed can help your mind feel calm and content!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to look over your work once more before turning it in"?
quests.question: Check Your Homework
quests.hint: This happens after homework is done, not while you're still writing it.
quests.explanation: Yes! We check our homework to make sure it's complete before turning it in.
quests.funFact: Checking your work is something even scientists and authors do before they finish a project!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to get your backpack ready before you go to sleep"?
quests.question: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow
quests.correctAnswer: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
options: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
quests.hint: This is done the evening before, not the morning of school.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack our school bag the night before so mornings feel calmer.
quests.funFact: Packing your bag the night before can save precious minutes on a busy school morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to set tomorrow's outfit out before you go to sleep"?
quests.question: Lay Out Your Clothes
quests.hint: This is done the evening before you actually wear the clothes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We lay out our clothes at night to make morning easier.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed lightning fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to review your answers before packing your homework away"?
quests.question: Check Your Homework
quests.hint: You look closely for mistakes during this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Checking homework means looking it over once more for mistakes.
quests.funFact: A quick second look can help you catch a small mistake before it's too late!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to tell your family one happy thing that happened today"?
quests.question: Share Something Good About Today
quests.hint: You think back over your whole day for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Sharing a happy moment helps us remember the best parts of our day.
quests.funFact: Sharing your day with someone you love is a cozy way to feel close before sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to think back and share a happy moment from today"?
quests.question: Share Something Good About Today
quests.hint: It's a happy memory you say out loud to someone you love.
quests.explanation: Well done! Talking about a happy moment is a lovely way to end the day.
quests.funFact: Thinking of one happy moment before bed can help your mind feel calm and content!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to place tomorrow's shirt and pants somewhere easy to find"?
quests.question: Lay Out Your Clothes
quests.hint: It saves you time searching for an outfit in the morning.
quests.explanation: That's right! Laying out clothes means choosing tomorrow's outfit ahead of time.
quests.funFact: Some children love picking a fun outfit the night before school!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to load tomorrow's books into your bag before bedtime"?
quests.question: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow
quests.correctAnswer: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
options: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
quests.hint: It makes tomorrow's morning feel calmer and less rushed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing the night before means your bag is ready before you even wake up.
quests.funFact: A little planning at night can make the whole next morning feel calmer!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to arrange tomorrow's clothes so morning is quick and easy"?
quests.question: Lay Out Your Clothes
quests.hint: A chair or a hanger might hold tomorrow's outfit for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A little planning at night helps mornings feel calm and quick.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed lightning fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to prepare your bag so morning feels less rushed"?
quests.question: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow
quests.correctAnswer: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
options: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
quests.hint: Books, homework, and supplies all go inside for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Getting ready early helps take the rush out of busy mornings.
quests.funFact: Packing your bag the night before can save precious minutes on a busy school morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to look for mistakes before your homework is finished"?
quests.question: Check Your Homework
quests.hint: This helps make sure your work is neat and complete.
quests.explanation: Well done! A careful check helps our homework be its very best.
quests.funFact: Checking your work is something even scientists and authors do before they finish a project!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to have a little bite to keep your energy up"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: You enjoy this between lunch and dinner.
quests.explanation: Well done! A healthy snack helps keep our energy up until dinner.
quests.funFact: A small snack can help keep your tummy happy until dinner time!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to suck up dust and crumbs from the carpet"?
quests.question: Vacuum the Floor
quests.hint: It works on carpets and rugs, not hard floors.
quests.explanation: That's right! Vacuuming means using a machine to clean a carpet or rug.
quests.funFact: The very first vacuum cleaners were much bigger and louder than the ones we use today!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to give outdoor flowers and vegetables a good drink"?
quests.question: Water the Garden
quests.hint: A hose or a watering can helps with this outdoor task.
quests.explanation: That's right! Watering the garden means giving outdoor flowers and vegetables a good drink.
quests.funFact: Watering a garden in the cool of the evening helps plants soak up water before the hot sun returns!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning and Night to keep your teeth strong and healthy"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: You do this twice a day, not just once.
quests.explanation: That's right! Brushing our teeth keeps our smile clean and strong.
quests.funFact: Baby teeth need brushing too, even though new teeth will grow in later!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to make a quick, crunchy breakfast in a bowl"?
quests.question: Pour Cereal
quests.hint: A bowl, a box, and a splash of milk are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pour cereal into a bowl to make a quick, crunchy breakfast.
quests.funFact: Cereal was first made as a quick, healthy breakfast that's easy to prepare!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to put your clothes away neatly instead of on the floor"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: You do this after you change out of your daytime clothes.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy closet starts with hanging up our clothes.
quests.funFact: Hanging up your clothes can help them stay neat and ready to wear again!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to watch for the bus to come around the corner"?
quests.question: Wait for the Bus
options: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
quests.hint: This happens before you climb aboard, not after.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waiting for the bus means standing patiently until it comes.
quests.funFact: Bus stops often have a sign so everyone knows exactly where to wait!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to make sure your work is complete before bedtime"?
quests.question: Check Your Homework
quests.hint: This happens after homework is done, not while you're still writing it.
quests.explanation: Yes! We check our homework to make sure it's complete before turning it in.
quests.funFact: A quick second look can help you catch a small mistake before it's too late!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to get your hair looking neat before school"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: A small tool with teeth-like edges helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We comb our hair in the morning to look neat and tidy.
quests.funFact: Hair can get tangled while you sleep, so a morning comb helps smooth it out!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to clean up plates and cups after dinner"?
quests.question: Wash the Dishes
quests.hint: Soap, water, and a sponge are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash the dishes after a meal to keep them clean.
quests.funFact: Washing dishes right after a meal makes the food much easier to clean off!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Anytime to fill your cup and take a refreshing sip"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: This helps your body feel cool and full of energy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Drinking water helps us feel refreshed all day long.
quests.funFact: Your body needs water to help you think, play, and grow every day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to greet your family with a cheerful hello"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: This is the opposite of the words we use at bedtime.
quests.explanation: Well done! A friendly good morning can make everyone feel happy.
quests.funFact: A cheerful good morning can help set a happy tone for the whole day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to tidy the table once dinner is all done"?
quests.question: Clear the Table
quests.hint: This happens right after a meal is finished, not before.
quests.explanation: Yes! We clear the table once everyone has finished eating.
quests.funFact: Clearing the table is a helpful way to pitch in after a family meal!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to arrange forks and napkins before dinner starts"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: You do this right before a meal begins, not after.
quests.explanation: That's right! Setting the table means placing plates and forks before a meal.
quests.funFact: Helping set the table is a simple way to help your family before a meal!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to organize your room so it feels calm and clean"?
quests.question: Tidy Your Room
quests.hint: Clothes, books, and toys all find their spots during this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Tidying a room means putting everything back in its place.
quests.funFact: Tidying up a little bit each day keeps a big mess from building up!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to give indoor plants a drink before they get thirsty"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: You do this for something green sitting in a pot, not a pet.
quests.explanation: Well done! Plants need water, sunlight, and care to grow big and strong.
quests.funFact: Plants use water and sunlight together to make their own food and grow!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to choose and set out clothes for the next day"?
quests.question: Lay Out Your Clothes
quests.hint: This is done the evening before you actually wear the clothes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We lay out our clothes at night to make morning easier.
quests.funFact: Some children love picking a fun outfit the night before school!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to enjoy a story before it's time to sleep"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: You might do this snuggled up with a favorite stuffed animal.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good book can help us feel calm and sleepy before bed.
quests.funFact: Reading before bed can help your mind relax and get ready for sleep!
